checks: Actual Web UI starts with unchecked consent and blank rights/use fields; real cloud Codex waits until the logged-in customer separately approves each exact audio proposal and quote
Web authenticates with actual email OTP and creates a real cloud Codex audio task; both tool outputs are retained through the company fixture gateway
Web decodes protected WAV and downloads exact SHA-256 bytes, displaying confirmed original company charges
Actual Web revision preserves original timed transcript and version two, makes no additional AI request, and keeps historical versions read only
A real concurrent subtitle change produces a CAS conflict and preserves the customer's stale edit rather than overwriting the newer version
The actual 800 by 600 Traditional Chinese dark audio layout reflows and retains complete job controls without horizontal overflow
Actual scoped Admin OTP/TOTP login displays original audio jobs, immutable model/capability identities and independently permitted company costs
Independent Admin body permission reads the exact original audio request and rights attestation with a persisted sensitive-access audit
Scoped Admin reads the actual independent customer confirmation and immutable events with sensitive-access audit; no administrator confirmation action exists
The real toolbar opens a native right SIDE_PANEL; actual OTP/PKCE loads the cloud task and WAV preview/save preserves exact SHA-256 bytes without Desktop
The actual native Side Panel removes a cue, requires manually supplied replacement times and saves cloud subtitle version four through protected CAS without another AI request

An actual new task from the native Side Panel waits for an unchecked, blank customer form; explicit confirmation permits one cloud audio POST and withdrawal blocks later delivery without a retry or Desktop dependency
Native audio layouts fit the actual narrow panel in both languages and the cloud-task panel survives active-page navigation
